selected_research.title: Coercion or Predictability?
selected_research.subtitle: Mandarin Adverb–Noun Constructions
selected_research.question: Do apparently construction-specific neural effects reflect categorical grammatical processing or continuous expectation-related processes?
selected_research.text: I combine EEG/ERP with predictors derived from pretrained language models, cloze probability, and semantic association to examine this question in Mandarin adverb–noun constructions.

selected_research.title: Orthographic Processing & the ND250
selected_research.subtitle: Handwritten and Printed Words
selected_research.question: Does the 250-ms ERP difference reflect orthographic-lexicon activation or a prediction-error signal?
selected_research.text: This project compares handwritten and printed words to investigate the functional interpretation of the ND250 during visual word recognition.

selected_research.title: Object Size & Semantic Representation
selected_research.subtitle: Words Referring to Small and Large Objects
selected_research.question: Which conceptual dimensions organize the neural representation of words referring to differently sized objects?
selected_research.text: This collaborative project combines behavioral experiments, EEG, multivariate decoding, and semantic ratings to study neural differences in word meaning.

computational_projects.title: LLM Surprisal for Mandarin Sentence Processing
computational_projects.problem: Quantify graded contextual expectation in Mandarin sentence materials.
computational_projects.data: Sentence stimuli, cloze norms, behavioral measures, and trial-level EEG.
computational_projects.output: Word-level surprisal predictors aligned with human behavioral and neural data.

computational_projects.title: Regression-based ERP Analysis
computational_projects.problem: Estimate overlapping categorical and continuous effects without reducing trial-level variability to condition averages.
computational_projects.data: Single-trial EEG with linguistic and computational predictors.
computational_projects.method: rERP · Linear mixed models · R / Python
computational_projects.output: Time-resolved estimates of predictor effects on neural activity.

computational_projects.title: Mass-univariate EEG Analysis
computational_projects.problem: Evaluate distributed effects across electrodes and time while controlling multiple comparisons.
computational_projects.data: Epoched EEG and condition- or trial-level predictors.
computational_projects.output: Exploratory spatiotemporal inference for ERP effects.

computational_projects.title: MVPA / RSA Pipelines
computational_projects.problem: Relate distributed neural response patterns to conceptual and model-derived representational spaces.
computational_projects.data: EEG patterns, semantic ratings, and representational models.
computational_projects.output: Decoding and model-alignment analyses of neural representations.
